description: Head-movement mini-game GA22, Wave 2 Group E (precision control): tilt angle-matching game, the roll-axis counterpart of GA21. Voice calls a side and a small angle (6 fixed trials: left 12, right 20, left 20, right 12, left 12, right 20 degrees); tilt the ear toward the shoulder into the target band (plus/minus 5 degrees) and hold steady 0.8 s to hit. Wrong side past 15 degrees or 10 s without a hit is a miss; return to center gates every next call. A one-prompt start calibration (tilt left once) learns which roll sign means left. Temple tap starts and replays; no camera, no mic/ASR.
name: tilt-match
